APP_TITLE: Setsi sa Thuto sa Bo-pula-maliboho ba Afrika - Kantle
WELCOME_SUB: Khoro ea ho Matlafatsa Afrika ka Pi Ecosystem
AFRICA_DAY: (Ho keteka Letsatsi la bo-25 la Afrika, App ena ea Koetliso ea Bo-pula-maliboho ba Pi e thakholoe)
INTRO_P1: Pi Network ke projeke ea chelete ea dijithale le ecosystem ea lefats'e lohle e etselitsoeng ho etsa hore cryptocurrency e fihlellehe le ho ba molemo ho motho e mong le e mong.
INTRO_P2: Ho fapana le li-cryptocurrensets tsa setso tse atisang ho hloka mechini e turu ea merafo le motlakase o mongata, Pi Network e lumella batho ba tloaelehileng ho nka karolo ka kotloloho ho tsoa mehala ea bona.
INTRO_P3: Pono ea Pi Network ke ho haha ecosystem e khannoang ke batho moo chelete ea dijithale e ka sebelisoang bakeng sa ts'ebeliso ea 'nete, lits'ebeletso tsa' nete, sechaba sa 'nete le ho nka karolo moruong oa' nete.
GLOBAL_MISSION: Morero oa Lefatše Lohle oa Pi Network
M1: Ho aha moruo oa dijithale o kenyeletsang motho e mong le e mong
M2: Ho matlafatsa batho ba tloaelehileng lefatšeng ka bophara
M3: Ho eketsa ts'ebeliso ea bophelo ba 'nete
M4: Ho ts'ehetsa khoebo ea motho le motho
M6: Ho khothaletsa ho nka karolo ha sechaba
CH1_SUB: Amoheng Setsing sa Thuto sa Bo-pula-maliboho ba Afrika - Kantle. Sethala sena se etselitsoe ho ruta, ho matlafatsa le ho lokisetsa bo-pula-maliboho ba Afrika le likhoebo ho nka karolo ka nepo ho Pi Ecosystem.
INVITE_LINK: Sebelisa sehokelo sa memo ea semmuso: https://minepi.com/chigalex1
REG2: Ingolise ka Facebook kapa Nomoro ea Mohala
REG4: Amohela moputso oa hau oa 1 Pi
DAILY_MINING: Merafo ea Letsatsi le Letsatsi: Khutla lihora tse ling le tse ling tse 24 ho tsoela pele ka merafo.
MAINNET_TITLE: Lethathamo la ho Hlahloba la Mainnet
MC1: Theha sepache sa Pi ka polokeho
WALLET_SEC: Tshireletso ea Wallet: Le ka mohla u se ke ua arolelana mantsoe a hau a 24 a Passphrase. Mang kapa mang ea nang le mantsoe ao ke mong'a sepache.
CH2_DESC: Ithute mokhoa oa ho amohela le ho romella Pi ka polokeho u sebelisa Pi Wallet ho Pi Browser.
CH2A_TITLE: KHAOLO 2A — KOETLISO E SEBENZANG EA PI WALLET
CH2A_DESC: Qala ka chelete e nyane ea teko, netefatsa aterese, le ka mohla u se ke ua arolelana passphrase ea hau.
CH3_DESC: Pi Browser DApps ke lits'ebetso tse arotsoeng bakeng sa ts'ebeliso ea 'nete.
CH4_DESC: Fumana likhoebo tse amohelang Pi lefatšeng ka bophara.
CH5_DESC: Boleng ba Tumellano ea Lefatše (GCV) bo khothaletsa ts'ebeliso ea 'nete ho ecosystem.
CH6_DESC: Ithute bukana ea Doris Yin bakeng sa popo ea ts'ebeliso le kholo ea ecosystem.
MERCHANT_DESC: Mokhoa oa ho kenela ecosystem, ho thathamisa khoebo ea hau ho MapOfPi, ho amohela tefo ea Pi.
FINAL_P: Afrika e na le monyetla oa ho ba e 'ngoe ea libaka tse matla ka ho fetisisa ts'ebelisong e sebetsang kahare ho Pi Ecosystem. Re aha hammoho. Re ruta hammoho. Re matlafatsa Afrika hammoho ka Pi.
